basicMistakes.text-over-text: Text overlaps other text, or a line, rule, bar, shape or logo runs through or sits on top of text.
basicMistakes.unreadable-contrast: Text a viewer cannot read against what is directly behind it: dark on dark, light on light, grey on grey.
basicMistakes.clipped-or-escaping-text: Text cut off, clipped mid-glyph, truncated mid-word, or spilling out of its panel or off the frame.
basicMistakes.empty-or-broken: The graphic shows nothing, or a frame where content belongs is empty or visibly broken.
basicMistakes.missing-action: The brief needs an operator action the operator surface does not offer.

airable.description: Would a broadcast director put this on air as delivered, today?

frame.description: The file it is visible in.

where.description: Which text or element, and where on the frame.

better.description: The one you would rather put on air for this brief.
